Step 3 (Historical Origins and Evolution): The Fifth Amendment says that accused persons in criminal trialsdo not have to testify (p. 18).
Step 4 (Historical Origins and Evolution): These amendments, combined withstatutes and case law, laws established by court decisions, make up the rights and procedures guaranteed to all (p. 18).
